meta.label: Demo company / Synthetic data
meta.business: Three general auto-repair shops (6 bays each, 18 bays) plus a shared office; no vehicle sales
meta.fiscal_year_note: Fiscal year runs November–October; FY2026 = Nov 2025–Oct 2026
meta.cash_week_convention: Consecutive 7-day weeks Sunday–Saturday starting 2026-11-01 (13 weeks, ends 2027-01-30).
cash_rules: Opening = actual operating bank 2026-10-31; processor clearing (GL 1010) and undeposited cash/ACH (GL 1020) settle in week 1 — not new revenue.

Known events from planning/commitments apply once per overlap key (open AR, open AP, unreceived POs, earned October payroll, October sales tax, debt service, November contract cycle). Appointment rows carry no amount and are demand only.
New retail sales are collected the same week at the trailing 8-week run rate; new fleet invoices are collected after the observed fleet lag.
Vendor/supplier payments: a week takes the larger of known AP/PO/contract items and the trailing 8-week vendor run rate, so nothing is counted twice.
Future payroll = average of the last four semi-monthly cycles, funded period end + 2 business days; future sales tax = trailing 3-month average, due the 20th.
Owner distributions, capital spending and income tax are excluded.
meta.cash_floor_note: Minimum bank reserve from the synthetic owner-distribution policy (planning data).

pnl_monthly.description: Monthly P&L from trial-balance period debits/credits (not closing balances) by location (LOC-01..03, HQ; COMPANY = sum, HQ once) and account, vs the original budget approved 2024-10-18. Revenue lines positive; contra-revenue 4090 (customer concessions) positive and subtracted; expenses positive; supplier warranty recoveries 5120 negative.

service_mix_monthly.description: Delivered customer (non-warranty) repair orders by delivery month and service template; invoice-line net sales, billed book hours and actual technician clock of exactly this cohort (efficiency = book / clock may exceed 100%).

comebacks_monthly.description: Free corrective (warranty comeback) repair orders by reported month: count, technician hours and parts cost. Supplier recoveries are booked separately in GL 5120.

marketing_monthly.description: Ad spend (daily platform data), platform-claimed conversions/value (overlapping attribution claims, not revenue) and observed leads by source channel; booked = lead became an appointment.

kpi_monthly.description: One row per month and entity (COMPANY, LOC-01..03, HQ): P&L subtotals vs budget (contribution = net revenue − technician payroll, parts COGS, net warranty, stock loss, sublet; EBITDA excludes 6600/6700), shop KPIs (customer RO by delivery date, ARO, book vs clock hours, efficiency, effective labor rate, technician utilization, physical bay utilization of all 18 bays, comebacks, estimate approval rate, ads/leads) and month-end balances from the trial balance.

margin_bridge_monthly.description: Package bridge from delivered RO-cohort margin (allocated technician labor) to the period GL contribution: concessions, idle/PTO labor, warranty labor and parts, labor timing, supplier recoveries, stock write-offs. Negative = reduces contribution. Management memo, not GL postings.

bank_monthly.description: Operating bank statement by month (one physical account; location tags are analytical).

bank_type_monthly.description: Bank movements by type: processor payouts, customer ACH, cash deposits, vendor payments, payroll funding, sales tax, debt service, owner distributions.

owner_distributions.description: Quarterly owner sweeps (equity, not expense). Synthetic policy: ≤ $1M each, keeping ≥ $450k in the bank; none assumed in the forecast.

open_ar.description: Unpaid customer invoices at 2026-10-31 after credits and allocations; fleet accounts (FLEET-…) pay partially and late; expected collection date is an assumption.

open_ap.description: Open vendor bills at 2026-10-31 (parts suppliers SUP-…, operating vendors VEN-…). Payroll, tax, debt and deposits are not AP.

ro_recent.description: Drill-down: every repair order delivered in October 2026 with invoice ID, service, net sales split, billed book hours vs actual clock and technician.

cash_schedule_13w.description: Known cash events after cutoff (open AR/AP, unreceived POs, earned payroll, Oct sales tax, debt service, Nov contract cycle, processor/undeposited settlement) deduplicated by overlap key, plus driver lines (future payroll cycles, sales tax, December contract cycle). New-sales receipts and parts purchases are added on the page from cash_drivers.

business_events.description: Designed business events of the synthetic case.

rows.story: FY2026 net revenue $8.61M (+5.2% YoY) but EBITDA $3.10M (36.0% margin vs 39.7% in FY2025).
Fewer but bigger jobs: customer RO 13,889 → 12,923, ARO $590 → $667.
Parts margin squeezed 46.5% → 42.2%: supplier costs +9% from Jul 2025 vs retail parts prices +4%.
Technician payroll $1.39M → $1.59M (+4.5% pay from Jan 2026, sixth technician per shop ramping up).
Oak Junction (LOC-03) comebacks: 97 in 18 months to Apr 2026 vs 129 in May–Oct 2026.
